🇲🇽📉 BBVA SLASHES MEXICO 2026 GDP FORECAST TO 1.2% — SPANISH BANK PLAYS DOWNGRADE GAME WHILE EXPORTS BREAK RECORDS

Spanish bank BBVA cut its 2026 Mexico GDP growth forecast from 1.8% to 1.2% on June 18, citing weaker investment and consumption. Chief economist Carlos Serrano warned Mexico 'could lose investment grade' status without a 0.9% fiscal surplus. Same bank's Saidé Salazar conceded the economy moves 'a tres velocidades' with exports remaining 'resilient' — Mexico still exports 664.84 billion USD globally, ranking 11th worldwide.

The same IMD dropped Mexico seven places to 62nd in its 2026 World Competitiveness ranking — putting Singapore (single-party state) at #1 and Hong Kong (PRC SAR) at #2. Sheinbaum has already rejected the S&P downgrade rhetoric and called the BBVA-line economists 'wrong.' Record FDI, record remittances (19.676 bn USD Q1), peso at 17.20, record exports — but Madrid's banks pump out the 'Mexico is failing' narrative on cue.

🇲🇽📱 MORE THAN HALF OF MEXICO'S 144.5 MILLION MOBILE LINES NOW REGISTERED — JUNE 30 DEADLINE LOOMS

Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum confirmed on June 18 that more than half of Mexico's 144 million 585 thousand active cell lines have been linked to their owners via CURP under the new federal registry created to combat phone extortion. As of mid-May, 48 million lines were on file; Pepe Merino's Agencia de Transformación Digital y Telecomunicaciones will deliver a full progress report on June 25, days before the June 30 cutoff.

Sheinbaum on the rationale: 'es importante para fortalecer la seguridad, que los teléfonos estén asociados a una persona.' Data is held by the telecoms — government only accesses it through formal investigations. The right-wing press is running 'Sheinbaum surveillance state' panic in Spanish-language pages while every gringo who lives in Mexico already gave T-Mobile his fingerprint.

🔥🇲🇽 FIFA IS A 'CORPORATE STATE WITH MARKET IMMUNITY' — PEÑA NIETO HANDED OVER THE COUNTRY

UNAM economist Oscar David Rojas Silva, writing in Contralínea, traces FIFA from its origins as a British schoolboy disciplinary tool to its 1974 capture by Adidas heir Horst Dassler and Brazilian operator João Havelange, who turned soccer into 'a neoliberal business venture' with institutionalized bribery and nepotism. Successor Sepp Blatter ran it the same way. Gianni Infantino still does.

Rojas Silva on Mexico specifically: 'la administración Peña Nieto otorgó las concesiones más generosas' of the three 2026 hosts, signing state-level contracts that permanently shield FIFA agreements from modification — surrendering sovereign negotiating power. FIFA captures collective leisure time, imposes dynamic pricing, secures tax exemptions, and uses public infrastructure without paying. That's the Mundial business model. Peña wrote it into law.

🇲🇽🎬 LOTENAL HONORS 80 YEARS OF MEXICAN CINEMA — 3.6M TICKETS FOR THE AMACC, 21 MILLION PESO PRIZE

Mexico's National Lottery printed 3.6 million tickets bearing the logo of the Mexican Academy of Cinematographic Arts (AMACC) for draw 4019 — a state tribute to 80 years of the institution that hands out the Ariel prizes for Mexican film. Lotenal director Olivia Salomón and AMACC president Daniel Hidalgo announced a July 7 drawing with a 21 million peso grand prize across three series and a 66 million peso total pool. Actors Dolores Heredia and Juan Manuel Bernal attended the unveiling.

While Hollywood franchises bleed Latin America dry and streamers buy up catalogs at gringo prices, Mexico's state lottery is bankrolling its own art form — and AMACC keeps partnerships with UNAM's Filmoteca, IMCINE, and the Cineteca Nacional. Cultural sovereignty isn't a slogan, it's a line item.

🔥🇲🇽 EX-INE COUNSELORS BUILD OWN POLITICAL PARTY — SLAPPED WITH SANCTION WORTH UNDER 3% OF WHAT THEY SPENT

The group 'Personas Sumando,' led by former counselors of Mexico's electoral institute INE, is on the verge of obtaining party registration — and the fine for accounting irregularities came in at 327,427 pesos against 11.2 million pesos in reported promotional spending. That's less than 3 percent. They reported the highest income among four finalist associations in the registration process, which began in January last year, yet got the lowest proposed sanction of any of them.

Same neoliberal technocrats who ran Zedillo and Peña Nieto-era elections now want their own ballot line. The 4T's judicial and electoral reforms came precisely because these institutions had been captured by figures like these — and the 'independent' INE machine is now organizing politically against the very people it was supposed to serve neutrally.

🚨🇲🇽 CNTE BLOCKS 7 AFORE HQs ON REFORMA — TEACHERS DEMAND ZEDILLO/CALDERÓN PENSION SCAM BE REVERSED

Mexico's dissident teachers' coordinator CNTE shut down seven private pension-fund Afore offices along Paseo de la Reforma on June 18, escalating the fight to abrogate the 2007 ISSSTE law that forced state workers into individual accounts run by financial corporations. The teachers want their solidarity-based pension system back. The Afores — created by Zedillo in 1997 and expanded by Calderón in 2007 — have skimmed billions in commissions while paying out worse benefits than the public system they replaced.

CNTE consigna: 'exigimos la devolución total del control de nuestras pensiones.' Mesas with Segob are stalled. Sheinbaum has promised a direct teacher-by-teacher August consultation that bypasses union leadership entirely.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>MEXICO-KOREA TRADE HITS $27B — BUT MEXICO RUNS $14.9B DEFICIT, SELLS RAW BUYS TECH</u>

As Mexico and South Korea face off at the Mundial, El Financiero pulls the trade ledger: $27 billion total, but Mexico runs a $14.9 billion deficit.

Mexico exported $6.05B in 2025 — crude oil, lead minerals, auto engines, zinc minerals (795% annual growth), precipitated copper (255%) — while importing $20.9B in Korean tech: electronics, semiconductors, computers, auto parts.

The pattern is the classic primary-export trap: Mexico sells raw, buys value-added. Sheinbaum's industrial sovereignty agenda exists precisely to flip this — domestic semiconductor parks, Pemex petrochemicals, CFE manufacturing.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>SHEINBAUM HOSTS KING FELIPE VI JUN 25 — INDIGENOUS APOLOGY DEMAND ENTERS PHASE 2</u>

Sheinbaum will receive King Felipe VI at the National Palace on June 25 — first official Mexico-Spain royal meeting since AMLO's 2019 letter demanding Spain apologize for the conquest.

Spain refused in 2019; Sheinbaum excluded the King from her 2024 inauguration. The thaw: Spain's foreign minister recognized "pain and injustice" to indigenous peoples in Oct 2025; King Felipe acknowledged "many abuses" in March 2026.

Her agenda: "indigenous peoples and their importance in Mexican history." Receive the King — on Mexico's terms.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>SHEINBAUM TO TRUMP: "NOT WELL INFORMED" — DROPS 46% HOMICIDE / 70% FENTANYL DATA</u>

Trump claimed Mexico "lost control of the country" at the G7. Sheinbaum at the mañanera today: "no hay que engancharse en cada declaración" — those comments target a US audience.

Then dropped the receipts to US Sec. Markwayne Mullin: 46% homicide reduction, 70% fentanyl-via-land collapse.

She praised Harfuch and Gen. Trevilla as officials who "devote their lives to Mexico despite personal risks" — contrasting the neoliberal era when officials served foreign interests.

🇲🇽🏭 <u>4T ELIMINATES 1,711 FEDERAL PROCEDURES; 3,497 SIMPLIFIED — DIGITAL STATE BUILDS OUT</u>

Peña Merino at the mañanera today: 3,497 federal procedures simplified, 1,711 eliminated entirely — 60% of the way to the 4,500 goal by end of 2026.

Passports: 21 steps → 5. Civil registry: 28 → 20. Consular services: 72 → 37.

gob.mx now serves 56 million Mexicans; Llave MX digital ID has 24 million accounts; Mi Registro Civil 18 million. Full federal digitalization targeted Q1 2027 — the neoliberal paperwork labyrinth dismantled in real time.
